Avoid the risk?
Or take on a harder game for a bigger reward?
Personally, I'm taking the snow game.

videos.script:
What if the more you used your favorite football play, the better it became?
That's exactly how mastery works in Fourth & Glory.
Every time you gain yards, convert a first down, or score with a play, it earns experience.
Earn enough XP, and you get to choose one of three upgrades.
You can upgrade a play up to three times during a run.
And bonus cards have their own mastery system too.
So that basic play you started with?
By the time you reach the championship, it could become one of the best weapons in your entire deck.

videos.script:
My football game had a BIG problem!
It was WAY too easy to just spam every bonus card in your hand. So I had to make a change!
Now, you can still use as many bonus cards as you want on a play… but there's a catch.
If you use ANY bonus cards, you only draw ONE new card after the play.
But if you save them? You draw TWO!
And every first down earns you an extra card!
So now you have to make a decision. Do you go ALL IN on one play, or save your cards for when you really need them?
Did I fix the problem, or just make the game harder?
